title: Make mobile navigation a full-screen editorial index
context: The owner rejected the mobile navigation, requested a redesign with animation, then required full viewport width and height.
options: Restyle the existing compact link list
Use a full-screen numbered index with grouped controls
choice: Use full-width cobalt and lime bands, oversized numbered links, grouped controls and an edge-to-edge contact footer. Keep the surface at viewport bounds while its contents fade and move 16px. Close the native dialog after its exit animation, then hand off navigation.
tradeoff: The menu requires its chunk on first use and animated exits add 240ms before navigation. Reduced-motion, lite and missing-animation-API paths act immediately.
